svg.desc: Codex Rig parallel execution — bounded multi-agent execution — gates G0–G8
svg.text: ↺ dashed = same stage reused, see its home card
bold = key name · italic = condition, bound or opt-out
parent-owned gates · host schedules the wave · parent integrates

g.text: request · scope · mutationspick the workflow route
DAG · one wave · locksrole-card hashes · plan digest
re-freeze changed scope orbaseline at G2

svg.text: ● runs as is · ◐ runs differently · — not stated

g.text: GATE CONTRACTS · PARENT-OWNED · ONE RULE EACH
dispatch never adds nodes, owners or deps
one fixed wave; never a later dynamic wave
no dependent work before complete join
requested mode / spawn count never suffices
conflict, scope change, drift → new plan
missing QA/challenger pass may withhold completion
INVARIANTS · EIGHT RULES EVERY ROUTE KEEPS
1 · plan frozen before dispatch; no nodes added later
2 · node eligible only when fully hash-bound
3 · downstream waits for every dependency join
4 · parallel = observed overlap, never a request
6 · unsafe parallel → same plan as serial-fallback
7 · no flag, env var or child grants write authority
8 · evidence minimized; telemetry HMACs runtime IDs

svg.text: child edits declared paths only, never commits

g.text: v3 portable policy, read-only, restricted, never
user approval after five-field brief; 1 attempt
auto, env, read or paid approval
schema-v1 reads only; promotion needs schema-v3
Sensitive task or no frozen policy
report unavailable; stay portable or serialize
no concurrent dispatch; re-plan or serialize
stop dispatch; serially re-plan unstarted nodes
Missing terminal, output, verifier or join
block node + dependents; no parallel claim
RECOVERY STAYS INSIDE THE FROZEN PLAN
terminal event; never integrate partial writes
same plan digest; keep evidence + worktrees
Non-normative maintainer reference, never a contract; update it with any gate, tier, approval or lifecycle change.
